name: Swar Shuaib
overview: Suwar Shuaib is a social comedy show that discusses various topics in Kuwait and the Arab region in general. The program presents positives through educational and guidance ideas in a comedic, entertaining, and engaging dialogue format. The program is presented by the Kuwaiti media personality Shuaib Rashid and produced by Balmakhba for Artistic Production in cooperation with the Saudi company U-Turn. The program is shown twice a month, as the company releases two episodes per month throughout the year. The program highlights social issues in Kuwait and the Arab countries and is interested in hosting the most controversial figures in the artistic, political, sports, religious, and medical circles.
